soldier: Body rather large; head and the anterior half of the pronotum orange-yellow, the antennae pale yellow, the mandibles reddish brown, the abdomen and legs yellowish white. Setae on the head very few; the labrum with ten to twelve long bristles; the periphery of the pronotum with ten to fifteen scattered long bristles and the middle region with only three to five; the abdominal tergites with more numerous soft hairs. Head oval, narrower anteriorly, widest at about the posterior third, the posterior margin slightly arcuate. Labrum lingulate, contracted at the anterior end, with a slight finger-like projection at the apex. Mandibles rather straight, the apices very slightly curved; the tooth of the left mandible situated above the middle, the portion above it distinctly more slender than the corresponding part of the right mandible; the right mandible has a distinct small tooth at the middle section and another near the base. Antennae with 17 segments, segments 3 and 5 shorter and smaller and nearly equal in length. Postmentum rectangular, the lateral margins slightly wavy, slightly narrower anteriorly, widest at the posterior third and slightly contracted near the base. Both the anterior and the posterior margin of the pronotum have a rather broad and deep median notch.
worker: Distinctly dimorphic, with a large and a small form; the antennae have 17 segments in both.
